scripts.preview: NUXT_CONTACT_DRY_RUN=true nuxt build && NUXT_CONTACT_DRY_RUN=true nuxt preview
scripts.golden: UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 vitest run --project engine engine/__tests__/golden.test.ts engine/__tests__/analysis.fixture.test.ts

scripts.e2e: NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_MY_CHARTS=true NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_PRACTICE=true NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_SCALE_LEVELS=true NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_CHANGES=true NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_FUNCTIONS=true NUXT_PUBLIC_FEATURES_KEY_SIGNATURES=true nuxt build && playwright test
